name: Nuvio Enhanced (IMDb build)
subtitle: A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.
description:
A free, open-source media app for your phone, your desktop, and the TV you already own.

Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's new in this build:
• Updated to Nuvio Enhanced 0.6.11-beta (luqmanfadlli's newest release)
• The addon logo on stream cards follows your setting again when sorting
• "Play best for this device" no longer picks streams that still need to download (⬇️ / ⏳)
• App is about 50 MB smaller on your phone (leftover debugging data removed)

Install: sign it in Feather with the same certificate as your installed Nuvio and install it over the existing app (don't delete the old one).

What's new in this build:
• New on the streams screen: Sort, Filters and "Play best for this device" (press and hold it to see why)
• Streams screen is smoother: sorting and filtering now run in the background
• Each release now starts with a plain "What's new" list

Same version number as before, so Feather won't show this as an update: install it again from the source to get these changes.

Install: sign it in Feather with the same certificate as your installed Nuvio and install it over the existing app (don't delete the old one).

Changes in Nuvio Enhanced 0.6.10 itself:
- perf(ios): memory optimization long sessions and 4K HDR/DV playback @luqmanfadlli
- feat(player): add Anime4K 2x upscaler and line sharpener for ExoPlayer and mpv (#337) @chrisk325
- fix(ios): detach the mpv metal layer before destroying mpv (#336) @luqmanfadlli
- fix(player): start playback service as a normal service first (NUVIO-MOBILE-D9 NUVIO-MOBILE-9E NUVIO-MOBILE-9M NUVIO-MOBILE-PC) @tapframe
- fix(player): cap buffer start times at the min buffer (NUVIO-MOBILE-1VH) @tapframe
- fix(player): guard caption setting reads (NUVIO-MOBILE-25M) @tapframe
- fix(network): treat SSL setup errors as failed requests (NUVIO-MOBILE-254 NUVIO-MOBILE-3N) @tapframe
- fix(watched): copy unsynced keys before saving (NUVIO-MOBILE-260) @tapframe
- i18n: add French translation for ratings strings (#2562) @SK-Gits
- i18n(el): sync the Greek locale with 0.6.9 (playback audio, downmix, ratings) (#2561) @nosvasedis
- i18n(he): translate party strings into Hebrew (#2557) @haveAnIssue
- i18n(he): translate servers strings into Hebrew (#2556) @haveAnIssue
- i18n(he): translate pip strings into Hebrew (#2555) @haveAnIssue
- i18n(he): translate autosync strings into Hebrew (#2553) @haveAnIssue
- i18n(he): translate mdblist strings into Hebrew (#2552) @haveAnIssue
- i18n(he): translate ratings strings into Hebrew (#2551) @haveAnIssue
- Update Japanese translation (#2559) @Joe00011
- i18n(vi): translate ratings strings into Vietnamese (#2550) @blueocean2308
- fix(player): reset addon subtitles only when the source changes @tapframe
- feat(autosync): shared engine, enable on iOS (#2535) @skoruppa
- fix(mdblist): remap anime episodes between addon and TMDB numbering (TV parity) (#2516) @kernexshadow
